key_decisions.decision: Keep learning warfare as a stated purpose, alongside the obedience test in verse 4.
Make both directions of intermarriage and specific genders clear, preserving the service clause.
Retain selling and serving under the named ruler, the region and eight years.
Keep Spirit, judging, war and repeated hand language; preserve the shorter regional name here.
Retain repeated evaluation and the LORD’s strengthening of the oppressor.
Keep left-handedness and tribal identity without assuming the precise cause of the right-hand restriction.
Retain the rare source measure rather than inventing an exact modern length; preserve placement.
Keep the bodily description that matters to the ensuing action without ridicule added by the translator.
Retain carved images with an alternative noted, identifying the king’s command and departure of attendants.
Retain both sides of the body and direct killing action.
Keep the physical sequence and a supported reading of the difficult final phrase, noting alternatives.
Retain the uncertain architectural term with a note, keeping escape and locking actions distinct.
Render the covering-feet euphemism intelligibly while recording its literal image in a note.
Keep the approximate number, description and no-escape claim.
Keep the unusual weapon, six hundred and separate rescue notice without inventing a reign length.
